delivery.outcome: wellmanifest_governance.pytest_sessionstart returns before gate resolution when session.config.option.collectonly is set, so pytest --collect-only probes (koru scan, doctor, IDE discovery) finish in collection time and report real suite health; sessions that can execute tests keep the full governance gate unchanged. The manifest assigns the previously unowned bridge path and its regression test to the integration workstream.
nonGoals: no changes to koru scan probe logic in src/koru/scan.py (application-owned; probe stays generic)
no weakening of gate enforcement for sessions that execute tests
no changes to project/governance-check.sh or the gate itself

architecture.decision: Early return in pytest_sessionstart on config.option.collectonly before gate existence check, recursion guard and base resolution; integration workstream ownedPaths gains wellmanifest_governance.py and tests/test_wellmanifest_governance.py

validation.evidence: collection completes with exit 0 well inside the 30s koru scan probe budget on a clean ticket checkout
collect-only session start never executes the gate subprocess
non-collect sessions still run the gate and still raise GovernanceGateError on gate failure
GOV-PASS for the ticket branch including the manifest ownedPaths extension and the GOV-SYNC-001 managed-file lock digest update
